summary: NETSTREIT Corp. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement establishing a new $400M ATM equity offering program, replacing a prior $300M program. The company enters into a sales agreement with multiple agents and forward sellers, allowing for sales of common stock from time to time. As of the filing, $256.1M in shares have been sold under the prior program, and 12.8M shares remain unsettled under forward sale agreements maturing September 2026 through March 2027. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation.
